description: ADR 01162: a screenshot reference image on a local address works with no setting. The seed step captures the page into the 8092 test server's static directory, so the reference matches the capture's size; the compare step then fetches it from http://localhost:8092 and PASSes. One browser per platform, so concurrent contexts never race on the shared reference file.

steps.description: Seed the reference where the test server serves it.
Compare against the reference by its localhost URL.
Remove the seeded reference from the served directory.
